jobs.title: Finance Data Engineer
Founding Engineer (Tech Lead) · Full-Stack, AI-native (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Remote in Deutschland · Vollzeit · €85.000–100.000 + 1,0–1,5 % Anteile

Warum es diese Stelle gibt

Infinos ist eine der größten Telemedizin-Plattformen für medizinische Abnehmtherapie in Deutschland. Wir machen einen mittleren 7-stelligen Jahresumsatz, sind profitabel und haben bis heute kein Investorengeld genommen. Zwei Gründer, ein Team von rund 8 Leuten, tausende Patienten, die wir jeden Monat behandeln.

Jetzt bereiten wir unsere Seed-Runde vor. Ich bin Jan, der technische Gründer, und bis heute der einzige Vollzeit-Entwickler. Ich suche die Person, die diesen Job von mir übernimmt: den Stack verantworten, Features bauen und deployen, das Team koordinieren und später mit mir das Engineering-Team aufbauen.

Was du machst

  • Unseren Stack verantworten: ein TypeScript-Monorepo mit 11 Apps und 32 Packages. Next.js, tRPC, Prisma mit Postgres, Trigger.dev für Hintergrundjobs, eine Expo-App für iOS und Android

  • Features von der Idee bis zum Deploy bauen, meistens mehrere pro Tag. Ein Großteil des Codes entsteht bei uns mit AI Coding Tools

  • Pull Requests reviewen, auch die, die Agenten geschrieben haben.

  • In Produktionsdaten nachschauen, wenn etwas nicht stimmt, und mit KI-Hilfe die Ursache finden.

  • Deployment und Infrastruktur: GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Postgres, Secrets, Monitoring.

  • Unsere Arbeit mit Agenten weiterentwickeln, zum Beispiel Agenten in der CI oder automatisierte Reviews.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • Woche 1: erster eigener Deploy in Produktion.

  • Monat 1: du reviewst alle PRs und kennst das Monorepo.

  • Monat 3: du bist für die Infrastruktur verantwortlich, hast bereits mehrere größere Features allein geshippt und sagst uns, was wir als Nächstes bauen sollten.

Wen wir suchen

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit produktionsreifer Software, ein guter Teil davon in TypeScript. Du hast schon Verantwortung für Deployments und Infrastruktur getragen.

  • Du arbeitest täglich mit KI-Coding-Agenten und kannst zeigen, was du damit gebaut hast. Das fragen wir im ersten Gespräch ab.

  • Docker, CI, Cloud oder Kubernetes hast du schon betrieben. Infra-Spezialist musst du nicht sein.

  • Du willst Entscheidungen treffen und dafür geradestehen.

  • Deutsch oder Englisch fließend.

  • Hilfreich, aber nicht nötig: Expo, Vercel AI SDK

Was wir bieten

  • €85.000–100.000 Fixgehalt, je nach Erfahrung.

  • 1,0–1,5 % virtuelle Unternehmensanteile (VSOP). Im ersten Gespräch rechnen wir dir vor, was das bei verschiedenen Exits wert ist.

  • KI-Tooling ohne Budgetgrenze: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Frontier-Modelle.

  • Remote in Deutschland, regelmäßige Teamtreffen.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit beiden Gründern.

  • Wenn das Team wächst, wirst du Head of Engineering.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, Hardware nach Wahl.

So bewirbst du dich

Kein Anschreiben. Schick uns hier über join: einen Link zu etwas, das du gebaut hast, ein paar Sätze, warum diese Rolle, und wie du KI in deinem Arbeitsalltag nutzt.

Wir antworten innerhalb von 3-5 Tagen. Dann:

  1. 30 Minuten Videocall mit mir. Ich erzähle dir, was wir bauen, wie die Zahlen aussehen und warum es diese Stelle gibt. Du erzählst mir, was du zuletzt gebaut hast und was du suchst. Danach wissen wir beide, ob es Sinn ergibt weiterzumachen.

  2. 60 Minuten technisches Gespräch. In der ersten Hälfte führst du mich durch ein Projekt, das du gebaut hast: Architektur, Entscheidungen, was du heute anders machen würdest. In der zweiten Hälfte öffne ich unser Monorepo, zeige dir, wie wir arbeiten und deployen, und du stellst Fragen. Kein Live-Coding, kein Algorithmen-Quiz.

  3. Ein bezahlter Probetag. Du bekommst ein echtes Ticket aus unserem Backlog und eine Entwicklungsumgebung mit Testdaten. Du arbeitest mit deinen eigenen Tools, so wie du es sonst auch tust, und am Ende reviewen wir deinen PR gemeinsam. Den Tag bezahlen wir als Freelance-Auftrag.

  4. 30 Minuten mit der Geschäftsführung über die Erwartungen beider Seiten: was wir in den ersten Monaten von dir brauchen, was du von uns brauchst, und wie wir zusammenarbeiten wollen.

  5. Schriftliches Angebot - vom ersten Gespräch bis hierhin peilen wir unter zwei Wochen an.

jobs.title: Head of AI Platforms & Deployment
jobs.description:
About Moneybox
 
At Moneybox, our mission is to give everyone the means to get more out of life. We're guided by our belief that wealth isn't about the money, it's about the means to more - more freedom, opportunities, possibilities, and peace of mind. Moneybox is an award-winning wealth management platform, helping over one and a half million people build wealth throughout their lives, whether they’re saving and investing, buying their first home, or planning for retirement.
 
Job Brief

Moneybox engineering serves more than 2M customers and runs a live service handling over 20M API requests a day. We have agreed a company-wide AI Platforms strategy, backed by a business case, and we are now building the team to deliver it. This is a newly created function and you will be its first hire.

The Head of AI Platforms & Deployment is a player-manager role reporting to the Engineering Director, owning both sides of that strategy: the AI Platforms capability pillars (control, monitoring and sandboxing; agentic workflow orchestration; knowledge capture) and the AI Deployment team of forward-deployed engineers who put AI to work on real business problems. You will be hands-on from day one - enabling business deployment of AI with the tools we have today - whilst also building and delivering a business-driven, multi-year AI platforms strategy and hiring and managing the team that executes it.

Why now:

  • AI offers Moneybox significant opportunities, and unlocking them safely means managing the risks that come with it. The controls and capabilities that make that possible (gateways, sandboxing, guardrails, monitoring, perimeter defence) need dedicated leadership to build.
  • Demand for AI-enabled business systems is real and, without a safe path, goes underground. Someone must own the graduation ladder from "works for me" to owned, reviewed business system.
  • We are hosting customer-facing AI models as part of our Aurora financial guidance service. Serving these safely, securely and at scale needs a dedicated engineering owner.
  • We need to evolve our current Claude, Gemini and other frontier LLM deployments into a coherent, safe and effective strategic deployment platform.
You are not coming in to write a strategy deck. Pace and learning are key: we expect you to run two tracks in parallel from day one - enable the do-ers, helping the business use AI safely with what we have today rather than gating everything behind platform build, and build the strategic platform. Key decisions should be made within your first two to three months and material platform improvements live within six. You will hire further engineers before the end of the year, growing the team as the benefits compound.

What You'll Do

Own the AI platform strategy. Risk management, horizon scanning, supplier selection and vendor management, business case ownership, and benefits realisation through a coherent, business-driven delivery roadmap that is trusted by stakeholders across Moneybox.

Build and lead the AI Deployment team. Hire, line-manage and set the engagement priorities and delivery standards for a team of forward-deployed AI engineers, working alongside embedded specialists while we hire. Grow into managing both the platform and deployment sub-teams as the function expands.

Own perimeter safety in an AI-native world. Set and own our defensive AI strategy, with execution carried out in collaboration with Tech Ops. Our Principal Cloud Architect, who owns overall cloud strategy, is a key partner.

Own AI platforms and costs. Harnesses, tooling, cost management, forecasting and optimisation (including usage-based pricing shifts), and the staff access model. This includes:

  • AI safety for internal use: sandboxing, policy, integrations, MCP governance, usage guardrails and monitoring expectations.
  • The three platform pillars: control, monitoring and sandboxing (LLM and MCP gateway, anonymisation, local hardening, sandboxed cloud agent hosting); agentic workflow orchestration (a "software factory" in the cloud with hybrid self-serve and engineering-managed workflows); and knowledge capture and organisation.
  • AI workflow tooling and the tiered graduation ladder from personal tool, to shared tool, to business system.
  • Evolving existing deployments: tactical enhancement of what we run today so it aligns with the strategic direction.

    • Own model hosting and scaling. Hosting and scaling for AI and model workloads, including the customer-facing models behind our Aurora financial guidance service, with execution in collaboration with Tech Ops. Model safety and performance for customer-facing AI is shared with our Decisioning and Data Science teams: they own what happens inside the model, you own everything surrounding it.

    Enable the do-ers. Give departments a working answer for using AI today - clear guardrails on what is allowed now and fast risk assessment rather than blanket restriction - and make sure demand arrives through the front door.

    This role is explicitly not ML model development or data science, general cloud infrastructure ownership, or general engineering delivery - although our squads and engineering leads are customers of the platforms you build.


    Who You Are
  • A proven engineering leader who has gone deep on AI. You have managed engineers and managers, run programmes, owned budgets and supplier relationships, and in the last two to three years you have owned an AI platform or enablement capability in a real organisation. Not a spectator or strategist-only.
  • A player-manager. You are comfortable getting hands-on in the early months and equally comfortable stepping back as the team you have hired takes it on.
  • Strategic and accountable. You build and deliver a 12-18 month strategy aligned to company objectives, make well-informed and timely decisions, and take full ownership of your function's performance and commitments.
  • Unusually cross-functional. Every department is your stakeholder and customer. You will be recognised as the AI platforms expert at Moneybox, influencing exec and departmental leaders and resolving boundaries with Tech Ops and Decisioning through shared goals rather than turf.
  • A team builder. You will build this team from scratch rather than inherit one, establishing a performance culture, developing your people, and running a team that itself models AI-enabled productivity.
  • Commercially literate. You can express platform investment in ROI and EBITDA terms to a non-technical exec, and defend a risk position - on a connector approval, a token-versus-agent permission gap, a vendor - with clear reasoning.

    • Experience & Skill

    Essential

  • Proven engineering leadership: has managed engineers and managers, run programmes, owned budgets and supplier relationships.
  • Has owned an AI platform or enablement capability in a real organisation in the last 2-3 years: deployed AI tooling company-wide, set governance, managed cost at scale.
  • Has built or significantly scaled a team.
  • Current, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack: frontier model platforms, agentic tooling and harnesses, MCP and integration patterns, evals, prompt and context engineering.
  • AI security and governance: sandboxing, gateways (LLM, MCP, AI), DLP, guardrail enforcement and data-boundary reasoning; able to form and defend risk positions.
  • Cost engineering: usage-based pricing models, forecasting and optimisation levers.
  • Enough software and cloud architecture depth to hold your own with Architects, Tech Ops and Decisioning, and to get hands-on with the platform in the early months. Our core stack is .NET on Azure and Python is the standard for AI, so we need polyglot pragmatism over allegiance to any single stack.
  • Vendor and supplier evaluation and management in a fast-moving market.
  • Evidence of business-case thinking: can express platform investment in ROI and EBITDA terms to a non-technical exec.

    • Desirable

  • Experience in financial services or another regulated industry, or a comparable risk-context environment.
  • Hands-on experience selecting or implementing LLM/MCP gateways, sandboxed agent hosting or agentic workflow orchestration platforms.
  • Experience serving customer-facing AI models in production and partnering with data science teams on model safety and performance.

Scento est le plus grand site de décants de parfum d'Europe. Fondée en 2024, l'entreprise a son siège à Paris, place Vendôme, et un second bureau à Berlin. At MESH, we're developing autonomous robotic systems that automate the planning, handling, and assembly of reinforcement for the construction industry. Our multidisciplinary team spans robotics, AI, software, mechanical engineering, and digital fabrication, turning cutting-edge research into industrial products deployed on construction projects worldwide.

Tasks

As industrial robots become increasingly autonomous, perception, data, and AI are transforming how they understand and interact with the physical world. As a Robotics & Physical AI Intern, you will contribute to the development of intelligent robotic systems capable of perceiving, planning, and acting in complex industrial environments. You will work on one or more of the following projects:

  • 3D perception using industrial depth cameras
  • Multi-sensor calibration and robot perception
  • Point cloud processing, geometry processing, and 3D scene understanding
  • Foundation models and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems
  • Robotic grasping and manipulation
  • Motion planning and trajectory optimization
  • Reinforcement learning and imitation learning
  • Robot simulation using Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or Gazebo
  • Data collection, annotation, and evaluation
  • Deployment and integration of AI models with industrial robotic systems

  • Robot kinematics and dynamics
  • Motion planning (MoveIt, OMPL, or similar)
  • Robot simulation (Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo, or similar)
  • CUDA / GPU programming
  • Experience with industrial robots (e.g. ABB)

We don't expect candidates to have experience with every technology listed above. Curiosity, strong programming fundamentals, and a willingness to learn are more important than prior experience with specific robotics frameworks.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Switzerland or be eligible to obtain the required Swiss work authorization without employer-sponsored visa support.

About the Role

Imagine pioneering the mathematical and logical foundations that enable AI to fly safely in real-world, safety-critical aviation. As a Machine Learning Certification Researcher, you will address one of the most fundamental challenges in modern AI: proving that ML models are safe, reliable, and mathematically sound for deployment in autonomous flight. Your work will bridge the gap between cutting-edge statistical learning theory and formal aviation certification frameworks, building upon previous work (EASA CoDANN I and II, and FAA report DOT/FAA/TC-21/48), and putting real-world systems to the test.

At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight technologies. We develop next-generation unmanned aerial systems that deliver greater speed, precision, and efficiency, supporting governments and defense organizations in mission-critical operations worldwide. Daedalean AG, the AI and autonomy hub of the Destinus Group, plays a key role in this vision—developing safety-critical AI systems at the intersection of advanced research and real-world aviation. Enabling machines to perceive, understand, and make decisions in real time, we combine aerospace engineering and artificial intelligence to build the next generation of autonomous flight systems, driving innovation where it matters most.

What You'll Do

• AI Certification Strategy: Analyze our existing AI certification strategy and help adapt it—or pioneer entirely new strategies—to certify different supervised ML.

• EASA Framework Alignment: Connect mathematical guarantees, technical arguments, and model evaluations to the EASA W-shaped process for AI certification in aviation, ensuring our research aligns with the latest regulatory guidelines.

• Theoretical Foundation & Modeling: Conduct research into statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and mathematical guarantees for deep neural networks operating under dynamic real-world conditions.

• Uncertainty Quantification: Apply statistics and stochastic processes to model environmental uncertainties and sensor noise, and to quantify confidence in performance metrics.

• Literature & Proof Evaluation: Critically evaluate academic literature, mathematical proofs, and engineering assumptions with peer-review rigor to identify safety limitations and theoretical gaps in state-of-the-art AI.

• Regulatory & Audit Justification: Construct robust, logical arguments and technical justifications that translate complex, high-dimensional empirical data into structured evidence for safety audits and certification frameworks.

• Algorithmic Validation: Write clean, reproducible code in Python to test theoretical hypotheses, validate certification mechanisms, and benchmark model safety frameworks.

Requirements

What You'll Need

Machine Learning Theory & Mathematics

• ML Theory & Statistical Learning: Deep understanding of statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and the mathematical foundations of deep neural networks.

• Statistics & Stochastic Processes: Strong background in advanced probability, statistical modeling, and stochastic processes.

• Python Engineering: Proficiency in Python with the ability to write clean, reproducible code (can also be learned on the job provided strong theoretical foundations and basic Python coding).

Research Rigor

• Scientific Research Methodology: Demonstrated capability or background in conducting comprehensive literature reviews, identifying gaps in current state-ofthe-art AI, and synthesizing complex academic concepts into actionable engineering frameworks (can also be learned on the job if you possess a strong quantitative baseline).

• Peer Review Expertise: Ability or experience in the peer-review process—capable of critically evaluating mathematical proofs, algorithmic assumptions, and research papers to assess their validity and limitations.

Education

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Theoretical Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related quantitative research field.

Who You Are

• Critical Thinking & Healthy Skepticism: You possess a strong spirit of questioning everything. You naturally challenge conventional ML assumptions, probe for hidden edge cases, and refuse to take empirical accuracy at face value without rigorous proof.

• Logical Argument Building: You have an exceptional ability to construct robust, airtight logical arguments and technical justifications. You can translate complex empirical observations into structured, defensible evidence that satisfies strict

engineering and regulatory scrutiny.

  • Build models for treatment effects, uplift, and counterfactual prediction

  • Develop constrained optimization models for promotion and incentive allocation

  • Read research papers, prototype ideas, and turn the ones that work into real systems

Prior experience with promotions, pricing, ads, recommendations, logistics, marketplaces, or other allocation and decision systems is a strong bonus, but not required.

  • Great workspace: Modern office in Amsterdam South with free barista coffee and NS travel card for your commute

This internship puts you at the intersection of modern AI, causal inference, and real-world decision making. If you like mathematics, experimentation, machine learning, and LLMs, and want to work on problems where models are used to make real decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product engineers to own product areas within Doit's AI Investing.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Production Scientist (Senior)
jobs.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

This is not a lab technician position. This is a senior scientist who owns assay quality, data QC and controls, and production troubleshooting across the entire experimental pipeline.

The production team runs 150+ experiments per month across expression, BLI, SPR, thermostability, and enzyme activity. When something goes wrong (failed expression, anomalous binding data, instrument artifacts), this person diagnoses the root cause and fixes it. As the assay and instrumentation portfolio expands, this person translates new R&D methods into production-ready protocols, builds robust methods that junior technicians can execute reliably, and designs comprehensive controls that enable automated QC and data processing.

This is a player-coach position. You will still run experiments personally, especially as you integrate into the lab, but you will also elevate the whole team's capabilities.

What You'll Do

  • Troubleshoot production failures across the full pipeline. A batch of proteins isn't expressing: is it the construct design, the expression system, or the media? BLI sensorgrams look noisy: is it the sensor tips, the sample prep, or an instrument issue? You figure it out, fix it, and make the cause easier to identify next time.

  • Develop and document SOPs for new assays as the portfolio expands. Take methods from the R&D team and make them production-ready: robust, reproducible, and executable by junior technicians without hand-holding.

  • Mentor a growing production team. Set quality standards, review data, train new hires, and build a culture where people flag problems early instead of hiding them.

  • Work at the intersection of biology, automation, and QC. Collaborate with researchers, laboratory technicians, and automation engineers on protocol optimization for work cells, and with software on LabOS protocol integration.

  • Own the relationship between assay science and throughput. The easy version of every assay doesn't scale, and the scalable version often sacrifices quality. You find the right tradeoff.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep hands-on expertise in protein production: expression (E. coli, mammalian, cell-free), purification (IMAC, SEC), and biophysical characterization (BLI and SPR at minimum). This isn't negotiable. You need to have done this work yourself, at volume.

  • PhD in protein biochemistry, biophysics, or structural biology, plus 3-5 years in a production or development role at a CRO, foundry, or high-throughput lab. Academic postdocs count if the work was high-throughput and production-oriented.

  • Experience with high-throughput workflows. You're comfortable with 96-well plates and liquid handlers, not just single-column purifications. You've optimized protocols for scale, not just for one perfect result.

  • Mentorship mindset. You've managed or trained junior scientists before. You enjoy teaching and get satisfaction from watching your team grow.

  • Troubleshooting instinct. When data looks wrong, your first impulse is to understand why, not to rerun the experiment and hope it works.

  • Quality-obsessed but pragmatic. You care deeply about data quality, but you also understand that production has deadlines and sometimes "good enough" is the right call.

  • Bridge between R&D and production. You can speak both languages: the exploratory mindset of research and the reproducibility demands of production.

Details

  • Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site)

  • Type: Full time

  • Start date: ASAP

jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role Description
As a Real Estate Analyst at Checkout.com, you will provide dedicated administrative, data management, and operational support to the Head of Real Estate, focusing on mitigating risk and increasing efficiency across the global portfolio. This role is essential for managing high-risk operational tasks, such as lease event tracking, lease administration, budgeting and data reporting to ensure a structured approach and prevent critical errors.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lease Administration & Governance

  • Proactively track, monitor, and manage critical dates for all lease events, including renewals and break clauses, acting as the primary conduit for populating and managing the tools that host our Real Estate data.

  • Support the execution of Real Estate contracts by coordinating with Brokers, Procurement, Legal etc. to finalise signing, updating project budgets, and archiving completed agreements.

  • Manage operational risk by ensuring all key details related to lease obligations are accurately recorded, tracked and action is taken.

  • For business case generation, gather comparable evidence, property valuations, and market data to drive strategic negotiations.

  • Liaise with regional, business and central teams to capture the justification and data necessary for business case approval.

  • Manage subleasing activities, including monitoring sub-tenant compliance, tracking sublease income and key milestones, and coordinating with legal and property management teams.

2. Financial and Procurement Reporting

  • Coordinate with Finance, Tax and Procurement teams for Real Estate budgets, including updating and managing the Real Estate OPEX and CAPEX budget tracking tools.

  • Act as the central point of contact for all property-related budget reporting, preparing quarterly reviews in a clear, digestible format that includes Real Estate and Workplace costs - giving an all inclusive cost per desk / square foot / head.

  • Assist in reporting refurbishment or new office delivery costs, against business as usual spend for operational office locations.

  • Support the coordination of financial and legal documentation required for transactions, such as preparing group structure charts and financials for external parties (e.g., landlords).

3. Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Data Collation

  • Lead the coordination and collection of energy, water, and utility consumption data across the global portfolio to support future CSR reporting requirements.

  • Manage the challenge of obtaining utility data in co-working and serviced spaces where direct meter readings are complex, including liaising with local teams, operators and landlords to gather the necessary information.

  • Act as the conduit between the CEO Office and ESG/CSR teams to ensure our portfolio meets the needs of Sustainability policies and or regulatory requirements.

4. Departmental Administrative Support

  • Assist in due diligence and preparation of business cases by researching and reporting on regional office statistics (e.g., desk counts, utilisation, attendance, capacity & commercials).

  • Act as a key liaison for business case presentation and refinement.

  • Maintain dynamic headcount forecasts to ensure space planning aligns with evolving business needs, particularly for high-growth regions.

  • Monitor and document team shift patterns to inform workspace strategy (e.g., HVAC service requirements, after-hours access, and desk rotation models).

  • Monitor and manage utilisation reports for Serviced Offices, along with onboard and offboard leaves to locations where we do not directly manage access control.

  • Maintain the central digital repository for all property documentation (leases, contracts, floor plans, and insurance certificates), ensuring strict naming conventions, accessibility, and version control are met to ensure 100% audit-readiness.

  • Schedule and prepare agendas, collate pre-read materials, and document meeting minutes for key real estate governance forums, proactively tracking action items to ensure timely closure by stakeholders.

  • Managing the administrative aspects of the "joiner/leaver" process for office access where no assigned Workplace / People person is assigned.

  • Act as the primary administrator for processing property-related invoices, performing the initial "first-pass" review to flag discrepancies against purchase orders (POs) and ensuring all costs are accurately coded before final submission to Finance.

5. Health, Safety & Physical Security Management

  • Coordinate the global H&S audit schedule in partnership with SMEs, managing the central audit database, evidence library, action log, and training records to track progress and compliance.

  • Support the weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting framework to surface risk trends and audit completion status, allocating audits to regional teams for execution.

  • Own the scheduling, chasing, and evidence trail for the audit lifecycle, acting as the primary administrative point of contact to ensure smooth execution.

  • Drive the audit lifecycle by ensuring all actions are identified, triaged, and managed to resolution, proactively identifying blockers and managing overdue items.

  • Ensure regional teams interpret and apply the central H&S framework in accordance with local laws while maintaining the global baseline standards.

  • Manage the integration of the H&S framework with wider Real Estate RACI to ensure clear accountability and prevent overlaps in responsibilities.

  • Implement and maintain physical security policies and standards across all global office locations.

  • Instruct periodic physical security risk assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security protocols.

  • Oversee visitor management processes and physical security measures to safeguard personnel and assets.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

  • Design and execute testing strategies for AI-powered features, validating not only functional correctness but also the quality, relevance, consistency, and safety of AI-generated outputs.

jobs.title: Scientist, Protein Expression & Purification
jobs.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

You'll build out protein expression and purification at Adaptyv, with a focus on mammalian systems — CHO and HEK, transient and stable. This is the foundation the rest of the platform stands on: titers, quality, and turnaround here set the ceiling for everything downstream.

Your job is to take expression and purification from bespoke, person-dependent protocols to a robust, automated, high-throughput product. You'll optimize and run the science hands-on, work with lab automation to scale it onto liquid handlers and automated systems, and work with the software team to track samples, capture process data, and make production observable and predictable. You'll lead the science and stay deeply hands-on.

What You'll Do

  • Develop, optimize, and run mammalian expression hands-on (CHO/HEK, transient and stable), pushing titer, quality, and reproducibility.

  • Own purification across modalities (Protein A, IEX, SEC, and related) and the quality of the proteins we ship.

  • Turn expression and purification into a productized, high-throughput, automated capability with predictable turnaround.

  • Partner with lab automation to scale workflows onto automated systems, and reduce manual, person-dependent steps.

  • Work with the software team to track samples and process parameters, and make production yields and quality observable and improvable.

  • Set the quality bar and troubleshoot the inevitable failures across biology, reagents, and process.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in mammalian protein expression and purification — CHO/HEK, and the full path from construct to purified, characterized protein.

  • Applied industry experience. You've run expression and purification in a production or industrial setting — where yield, reproducibility, and turnaround mattered at scale — not primarily in an academic research project. This is the core requirement.

  • Track record of making production reliable — titer optimization, scale-up, and consistent quality, not one-off preps.

  • Builder who moves fast. You want to stand up and continuously improve a production capability, not run a fixed protocol.

  • Interdisciplinary. You collaborate naturally with automation engineers and software people, and you see automation and data as core to a modern production process.

  • Data fluency (scripting, tracking and analyzing process data) is a strong plus.

Details

  • Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site)

  • Type: Full time

  • Start date: ASAP

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

What you'll do

The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will:

  • Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.

  • Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer.   • Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.

  • Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.

Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

 

We are hiring a Senior Performance Engineer to grow our pre-training efficiency team. If you are excited about making models fast and scaling them to thousands of GPUs, this is the role for you!

Team Culture

At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision‑making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.

About the role:

You will engineer the systems required to train foundation models at scale. Your objective is to maximize hardware utilization and training throughput on our large-scale GPU clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs). You will work at the intersection of deep learning frameworks, distributed systems, and GPU microarchitecture, eliminating bottlenecks from the Python layer down to the GPU kernel.

This role is for Aleph Alpha Research GmbH.

Your responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Optimization: Profile training loops using PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems and Nsight Compute to identify system- and kernel-level bottlenecks in order to maximize model throughput.

  • Distributed Strategy and Topology: Configure and tune composite parallelism strategies (e.g. TP, DP, HSDP/FSDP, EP), optimizing load balance, minimizing critical-path bottlenecks, and managing communication-to-computation trade-offs for large-scale LLM training.

  • Hardware-Aware Modeling: Partner with AI Researchers to define model architectures for hardware efficiency without compromising convergence.

Your Profile

Basic Qualifications

  • Are proficient in Python and the PyTorch library.

  • Have a strong engineering background in parallel and/or distributed systems with proven track record of excellence.

  • Have hands-on experience with modern machine learning techniques (especially large language models and their life cycle).

  • Deeply understand the CUDA programming model.

  • Have experience in distributed programming with APIs like NCCL or MPI.

  • Have experience analysing profiling traces with tools such as PyTorch Profiler and Nvidia Nsight.

  • Please note this role requires regular on-site collaboration in Heidelberg as a member of the Training Efficiency Team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Contributions to modern distributed training frameworks (e.g., TorchTitan, Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed).

  • Familiarity with low-precision training formats (MXFP4, MXFP8) and their impact on numerical stability and throughput.

  • A deep understanding of NCCL communication primitives, NVSHMEM or CUDA IPC and their performance.

  • A proven track record of implementing and optimising modern transformer-based model training.

  • A proven track record working on the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture.

Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About Moneybox
 
At Moneybox, our mission is to give everyone the means to get more out of life. We're guided by our belief that wealth isn't about the money, it's about the means to more - more freedom, opportunities, possibilities, and peace of mind. Moneybox is an award-winning wealth management platform, helping over one and a half million people build wealth throughout their lives, whether they’re saving and investing, buying their first home, or planning for retirement.
 
Job Brief

We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team and play a key role in shaping how data moves through Moneybox.

Working closely with our Data Engineering lead, you’ll act as a senior technical partner and take significant ownership of our data platform, architecture and engineering standards. This is a hands-on role, but one with broad influence across Engineering and Insight.

You’ll need to be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, making pragmatic technical decisions and taking ownership from problem definition through to production.


What You'll Do
  • Act as a senior technical partner within Data Engineering, providing continuity and ownership across the platform
  • Help set the technical direction and priorities for Data Engineering
  • Own, maintain and improve our core data processing and analytical platforms, with a strong focus on reliability, scalability and resilience
  • Design, build and maintain robust data pipelines and integrations across Moneybox systems
  • Lead the design of significant data architecture and integration changes
  • Build integrations to ingest new data sources and make them available across our analytical platforms
  • Partner with Backend Engineering and Insight teams to maintain reliable, accurate and meaningful data models as our products evolve
  • Establish and promote good engineering practices across data pipelines, modelling, observability, performance and reliability
  • Ensure data quality and integrity throughout our pipelines, identifying and addressing issues before they impact downstream users
  • Provide technical guidance to engineers and analysts working with the data platform
  • Work with Engineering, Information Security and Compliance to ensure analytical data is secure, appropriately restricted and handled in line with our policies
  • Monitor and improve the performance, efficiency and cost of our data processing platforms
  • Take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them through to resolution
  • Keep up to date with developments in data engineering and identify where new technologies or approaches could deliver meaningful value
  • Contribute to the wider engineering community at Moneybox, sharing expertise and helping raise standards across our technology estate

    • Our Data Technology Stack
  • Cloud: Microsoft Azure
  • Data platforms: Azure Databricks, SQL Server, Cosmos DB and Blob Storage
  • Data processing: Python, Spark and SQL
  • Messaging: Azure Service Bus and Event Hubs
  • DevOps and infrastructure: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions and Terraform

    • You don’t need to have worked with every technology we use, but we expect you to have strong experience with comparable technologies and the ability to learn quickly.


    Who You Are
  • An experienced data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building reliable systems
  • Comfortable taking significant ownership and operating with a high degree of autonomy
  • Able to act as a trusted technical partner and help shape technical direction
  • Pragmatic and able to balance strong engineering practices with the needs of a fast-moving business
  • Curious and motivated by improving systems, processes and ways of working
  • A strong communicator who can explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Someone who cares about the quality of their work and the impact it has on customers and colleagues
  • Comfortable working across team boundaries and bringing clarity to ambiguous or complex problems

    • Skills & Experience

    Essential

  • Strong experience designing, building and operating scalable production data pipelines
  • Strong understanding of ETL and ELT architectures and patterns
  • Strong programming and data transformation skills, particularly using technologies such as Python, Spark and SQL
  • Experience working with cloud-based data platforms
  • Experience designing systems for reliability, observability, performance and data quality
  • Strong understanding of data modelling and the principles behind well-structured analytical data
  • Experience making technical design decisions and taking ownership of significant engineering work
  • Ability to independently investigate problems and drive work through to completion
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and work effectively with a broad range of stakeholders

    • Desirable

  • Experience with NoSQL technologies such as Cosmos DB, DynamoDB or MongoDB
  • Experience with messaging or event-streaming technologies such as Azure Service Bus or Event Hubs
  • Experience using infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform
  • Understanding of REST APIs, authentication and API security
  • Experience working with sensitive or regulated data
  • Experience improving the cost and performance of large-scale data workloads

    • Whats in it for you?
  • The opportunity to join a fast-growing, award-winning and ambitious company
  • The chance to have a meaningful impact on the technology and data capabilities behind Moneybox
  • A friendly and highly motivated team
  • A collaborative and inclusive culture where your ideas will be heard
  • Company bonus scheme
  • Company pension scheme
  • Hybrid working
  • Home office furniture allowance
  • Personal annual learning and development budget
  • Private medical insurance
  • Health Cash Plan, including cashback on services such as dental and optical care
  • Cycle to Work scheme
  • Wellbeing and fitness benefits
  • Enhanced parental pay and leave
  • 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, with additional days based on length of service
